info.title: Converis Web Services
info.description:
This API Specification describes how to read data from Converis in order to use it in other systems. Additionally, you can create, update, or delete users and its roles through the API calls. 

## Access and Credentials 
This API reference is organized by resource type Data, Configuration and Administration. Each resource type has one or more endpoints. 

To use these endpoints, an API authentication token needs to be issued by the Converis administrator from the configuration screen (Configuration --> API Authentication Info). 
The table below specifies which type of endpoints require which ___type of service___ permission for the  Converis API authentication.

| Type of endpoint | Type of service permission |
| ---------------- | -------------------------- |
| Data             | CONVERIS_DATA_SERVICE      |
| Administration   | CONVERIS_ADMIN_SERVICE     |
| Configuration    | CONVERIS_CONFIG_SERVICE    | 
The generated API authentication token must then be provided per basic authentication with each request to the API (username = app name and password = generated token). 

The URL needs to be adapted to the Converis instance’s specific domain. 

The URL of API has the following pattern ___https://{host}:{port}/converis-apis/ws/v2/___ where *{host}* is the IP or the Hostname of your Converis installation. *{port}* must be provided only if it differs from 443. 

## Limits and Security
- The API allows max. 10 requests per second.
- All requests are secured through https (secure, TLS 1.2).

get.description:
Get user delegations based on the input criteria.

The different combinations of input query parameters are as below. Any other input parameter combinations are not allowed.
- delegationId fetches only that specific delegation.

- fromUserName fetches delegations from this username.

- fromUserName, entryPointId, roleName combination fetches delegations of this role and entrypoint by user fromUserName.

- startDate fetches delegations that start on this date.

- endDate fetches delegations that end on this date.

- searchFromUser fetch the delegations where the username/firstname/lastname of the from user contains this string.
  Maximum 2 search words are possible.
- searchToUser fetch the delegations where the username/firstname/lastname of the to user contains this string.
  Maximum 2 search words are possible.
- startRecord and count fetch count number of delegations starting from the position of startRecord.
  This can be combined with any other valid combination.
- No query parameters, fetch all the delegations.

parameters.name: delegationId
parameters.description:
Fetch only this delegation.

This parameter can be used only with startRecord and count

parameters.name: fromUserName
parameters.description:
Fetch delegations from the user whose loginname is fromUserName.

If parameters roleName and entryPointId are also passed, fetch delegations of role roleName with entrypoint entryPointId from the user fromUserName.

This parameter can be used with startRecord and count.

If provided, roleName and entryPointId both have to be provided.

parameters.name: entryPointId
parameters.description:
Used in combination with fromUserName and roleName.

Fetch delegations of roleName and entryPointId by fromUserName.

This parameter can be used with startRecord and count.

fromUserName and roleName are mandatory to be provided with this parameter.

parameters.name: roleName
parameters.description:
Used in combination with fromUserName and entryPointId.

Fetch delegations of roleName and entryPointId by fromUserName.

This parameter can be used with startRecord and count.

fromUserName and entryPointId are mandatory to be provided with this parameter.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description:
Fetch delegations that start on this date.

In the format yyyy-MM-dd

This parameter can be used only with startRecord and count.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description:
Fetch delegations that end on this date.

In the format yyyy-MM-dd

This parameter can be used only with startRecord and count.

parameters.name: startRecord
parameters.description:
Starting record.

Defaults to 1, the first record.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records to return.

parameters.name: searchFromUser
parameters.description:
Delegations where from user's login/first/last name contains this text are returned.

A maximum of 2 search words are possible together and they are seperated by a space.

This parameter can be used only with startRecord and count.

parameters.name: searchToUser
parameters.description:
Delegations where to user's login/first/last name contains this text are returned.

A maximum of 2 search words are possible together and they are seperated by a space.

This parameter can be used only with startRecord and count.

400.description: This response is returned in case of errors with request data.

get.summary: Get the linked data entity entries
get.description:
Get data entity entries of __type__ name that are linked to  ___link_type___ filtered by ___id___. Additionally, you can

  * specify language of attribute values through the query parameter ___language___
  * include (excluded by default) linkentity reference API path through HTTP header ___Converis-linkentity-references___. The information about link entities can be requested through the responded paths.
  * include (only basic attributes by default) specific or all attributes definitions of the entity through HTTP Header ___Converis-attribute-definition___

Please note that this endpoint returns the entity data. For link entity data use _/data/linkentities/{link_type}/linked/{type}/{id}_


Examples
***

Get the publications which are linked to the Journal 123
```
$curl https://converis.myuniversity.com/converis-apis/ws/v2/data/entities/Publication/linked/PUBL_has_JOUR/123
```

parameters.description: Type of the target entity

parameters.name: link_type
parameters.description:
linkType represents the link path that helps in getting the target type. The path could be either direct link with or without direction.

PUBL_has_JOUR - Direct link without direction

PUBL_has_PUBL - Direct link with same entity on both sides. `direction` necessary

 * ___L2R___ - Direct link with same entity on both sides with direction of traversal Left-2-Right
 * ___R2L___ - Direct link with same entity on both sides with direction of traversal Right-2-Left

get.summary: Get tree information by traversing it
get.description:
Get tree nodes for a given Data Entity type starting from the 
given start node and a traverse path.

In case of ___traverse=ANCESTORS___ the order of returned entity objects represents the path to the root node, i.e. the first entry in the response represents __start_node__ itself, the second entry is then the parent of parent of __start_node__ etc.

parameters.name: link_type
parameters.description: Name of the link entity type

parameters.name: start_node
parameters.description: The id of data object and the starting node by traversing the tree

parameters.name: traverse
parameters.description:
Traverse method which determines the level of data to be returned
* __ANCESTORS__ Path to root, starting from start_node
* __SIBLINGS__  Siblings,
* __CHILDREN__  Immediate Children,

timestamp.description: The date-time notation as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6, e.g. "2017-07-21T17:32:28Z"

statusDescription.description: Description of HTTP Status code, e.g. Bad Request

message.description: The detailed description of the error

delegationId.description:
id of the delegation.

To be passed in the request only for edit and delete delegation.

Returned in the response for fetch API.

startDate.description:
The date when the role delegation starts. Values must follow the pattern yyyy-MM-dd.

If this date is not provided, it is defaulted to current date.

In case of update API, if there is no change in the start date, it is expected to send the existing unchanged value of the start date.

endDate.description:
The date when the role delegation ends. Values must follow the pattern yyyy-MM-dd.

In case of update API, if there is no change in the end date, it is expected to send the existing unchanged value of the end date.

startRecord.description: The offset number from where the delegation record count begins.

count.description: The max number of records to be returned

nrRecordsFound.description: Total number of delegations returned for that request.

roleName.description: Converis user role - Please carefully check your Converis configuration. Do not provide names of the specific language. Special role names for admins can be used: Config Admin or Super Admin. For special roles no entryPointId is needed.

entryPointDataUrl.description: The entrypoint data url - only by GET Request

entryPointDefinitionUrl.description: Entry point definition url - only by GET Request
